title: Working Door
description: A door that opens when a player touches it and closes after a few seconds.
steps: Insert a Part, resize it into a door shape, and name it Door.
Turn on Anchored in the Properties window.
Insert a Script into the Door and paste the script below.
Press Play and walk into the door.

scripts.name: DoorScript
scripts.code:
local door = script.Parent
local open = false

door.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	if hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and not open then
		open = true
		door.Transparency = 0.7
		door.CanCollide = false
		task.wait(3)
		door.Transparency = 0
		door.CanCollide = true
		open = false
	end
end)

notes: If the door falls over, make sure Anchored is on.
Replace the example model ID with your own.

title: Day and Night Cycle
description: Make the sun and sky change smoothly from morning to night, over and over.
steps: Open your game in Roblox Studio.
In the Explorer window, find ServerScriptService.
Hover over ServerScriptService, tap the + button, and choose Script.
Delete the starter code inside the script.
Change DAY_LENGTH to make the day faster or slower. 120 means a full day takes 2 minutes.
Press Play and watch the sky change.

scripts.name: DayNightCycle
scripts.code:
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local DAY_LENGTH = 120 -- seconds for one full day
local START_TIME = 6 -- starts at 6 AM

Lighting.ClockTime = START_TIME

while true do
	local step = 24 / DAY_LENGTH * 0.1
	Lighting.ClockTime = (Lighting.ClockTime + step) % 24
	task.wait(0.1)
end

notes: Put the script in ServerScriptService, not inside a Part, or it won't run properly.
For a nicer sunset, add a Sky object inside Lighting and turn on Atmosphere.

title: Sprint and Stamina Bar
description: Hold Shift to run faster while a sleek stamina bar drains, turns red when low, and refills when you rest.
steps: Open your game in Roblox Studio.
In the Explorer window, find StarterPlayer, then StarterPlayerScripts inside it.
Hover over StarterPlayerScripts, tap the + button, and choose LocalScript.
Delete the starter code inside the LocalScript.
Paste the script below. It builds the whole bar by itself, so you don't need to make any UI by hand.
Change the numbers at the top to tune the speed, drain, and refill.
Press Play, then hold Left Shift while moving to sprint.

scripts.name: SprintStamina
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local UserInputService = game:GetService('UserInputService')
local TweenService = game:GetService('TweenService')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Settings (change these)
local WALK_SPEED = 16
local SPRINT_SPEED = 28
local MAX_STAMINA = 100
local DRAIN_RATE = 25 -- lost per second while sprinting
local REGEN_RATE = 15 -- gained per second while resting
local REGEN_DELAY = 1 -- seconds before it starts refilling
local RECOVER_AT = 25 -- stamina needed after getting tired
local NORMAL_FOV = 70
local SPRINT_FOV = 80

local stamina = MAX_STAMINA
local sprintHeld = false
local exhausted = false
local lastSprint = 0
local barVisible = false
local fovBoosted = false

-- Build the UI
local gui = Instance.new('ScreenGui')
gui.Name = 'StaminaUI'
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')

local holder = Instance.new('CanvasGroup')
holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
holder.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -40)
holder.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 24)
holder.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 20, 28)
holder.GroupTransparency = 1
holder.Parent = gui
Instance.new('UICorner', holder).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

local fill = Instance.new('Frame')
fill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255)
fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
fill.Parent = holder
Instance.new('UICorner', fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

local shine = Instance.new('UIGradient')
shine.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150))
shine.Rotation = 90
shine.Parent = fill

local label = Instance.new('TextLabel')
label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.Text = 'Stamina'
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.TextSize = 13
label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.6
label.ZIndex = 2
label.Parent = holder

-- Smooth animations
local info = TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)

local function showBar(show)
  if show == barVisible then return end
  barVisible = show
  TweenService:Create(holder, info, {GroupTransparency = show and 0 or 1}):Play()
end

local function boostFov(on)
  if on == fovBoosted then return end
  fovBoosted = on
  TweenService:Create(workspace.CurrentCamera, info, {FieldOfView = on and SPRINT_FOV or NORMAL_FOV}):Play()
end

-- Input (Left Shift)
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
  if processed then return end
  if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
    sprintHeld = true
  end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
  if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
    sprintHeld = false
  end
end)

-- Main loop
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
  local char = player.Character
  local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
  if not hum then return end

  local moving = hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0
  local sprinting = sprintHeld and moving and not exhausted

  if sprinting then
    stamina = math.max(0, stamina - DRAIN_RATE * dt)
    lastSprint = os.clock()
    hum.WalkSpeed = SPRINT_SPEED
    if stamina <= 0 then
      exhausted = true
    end
  else
    hum.WalkSpeed = WALK_SPEED
    if os.clock() - lastSprint > REGEN_DELAY then
      stamina = math.min(MAX_STAMINA, stamina + REGEN_RATE * dt)
      if exhausted and stamina >= RECOVER_AT then
        exhausted = false
      end
    end
  end

  -- Update the bar
  local ratio = stamina / MAX_STAMINA
  fill.Size = UDim2.new(ratio, 0, 1, 0)
  local red = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)
  local blue = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255)
  fill.BackgroundColor3 = exhausted and red or red:Lerp(blue, ratio)
  label.Text = exhausted and 'Tired!' or 'Stamina'

  showBar(sprinting or stamina < MAX_STAMINA)
  boostFov(sprinting)
end)

notes: This is a LocalScript, so it must go in StarterPlayerScripts. A normal Script will not work.
Sprint uses Left Shift, so it works on PC. For mobile you would need an on-screen button.
The bar hides itself when stamina is full, and it fades back in when you run.
If the camera looks wrong, set NORMAL_FOV to match your game's field of view (the Roblox default is 70).
